# safegit rebase

rebase the current branch onto upstream, guarded twice before git runs: the worktree operation lock -- held for the whole rebase, an interactive one's editor session included, so a second safegit process in this worktree waits that long -- and then a check for uncommitted work. A rebase's own --continue and --abort stay git's: safegit has no verb that finishes one

**Effect:** mutating
